title: 第2114章 在吗第2113章 星河师兄跟我欧阳明共情了
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 此次全四洲各大势力的大佬上门观看星河之光银盘的事情楚星河当然知道。
楚星河也自然清楚这些大佬来的目的是什么！
接下来订购这一块儿肯定是少不了的对吧！
毕竟这种东西，虽然短时间内可能不会有太大的作用，但是一个成功的大佬，一定不是只看眼前利益的那种。
传承对于任何一个势力都绝对是最重要的。
你瞅瞅哪怕是邪影洲的众多邪主都来到了昊天圣地！
虽然邪影洲的邪灵各种机关算计，但是邪影洲的邪灵也必须要有自己的传承。
而星河之光银盘一旦普及开来，三代五代的可能没有太多的作用，可是再往后，诞生出来的天骄数量会越来越多。
没有人会嫌弃自己家的弟子优秀！
自家的弟子越是优秀未来，自家势力也越有保障。
所以这种情况下各方一定是铆足了劲儿的下订单，然后购买银盘一级一级的给自家的弟子配备上。
如此时间会给出所有人最满意的答案！
所以这种情况下，楚星河有想过要不要自己跳出来一手免费呢？
但最终楚星河还是放弃了这个打算！
这特么免费的亏我楚星河还吃的少吗？
我这边万一免费之后再出现什么全新的幺蛾子可咋整？
所以思来想去楚星河表示不行，这一把老子要从其他地方下手，老子必定要把这星河之光血赚的机会彻底毁灭掉！
所以当天，楚星河找到了欧阳明。
“星河师兄！”
“嗯……欧阳啊，来来来，把星河之光银盘的打造方法全部灌输到这永生玉符之中！”
“啊？好……好的！”欧阳明虽然不知道星河师兄为什么要让自己把打造方法灌输到永生玉符之中，但是欧阳明还是毫不犹豫的照做了。
“检查一下，确定没有错误吧！”
“星河师兄放心，不可能有错的！”
“那好……你该干啥干啥吧……”
“哦……”欧阳明一脑门的问号。
楚星河拿着手中的永生玉符，反复的检查了一下，没毛病，里面全部都是星河之光银盘的打造方法！
拿着这永生玉符，楚星河脸上露出了一个微笑！
变身！七仙女儿！
刹那之间，楚星河完成了变身……重新化身成为星河黑子团七仙女儿！
随之楚星河拿出了自己从二驴子那边儿得到的黑河令！
找到二驴子的联系方法，随之发送消息：“在吗？”
看着消息发送完毕，楚星河脸上也露出了一丝阴险的笑容！
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿……没错！老子这一把就是要从根源上解决星河之光银盘可以嘎嘎血赚的问题！
上一次老子把偷天换日丹的炼制手法泄露出去，结果这特么偷天换日丹必须要有朱雀炉才能炼制？这特么是不是过于离谱了？
而这一次，楚星河明确的询问了欧阳明，这星河之光的银盘不会只有你欧阳明才能炼制吧？
对此欧阳明表示，星河师兄放心，这星河之光银盘的炼制方法简单，炼器师都能炼制！
听到这个答案楚星河还不放心，再次询问欧阳明表示这玩意儿该不会需要什么特定的物件儿才可以炼制吧？
对此欧阳明表示不需要啊……这么简单的东西，什么炼器炉都能炼制！
content_en:
Of course Chu Xinghe knew about the fact that the big bosses from all the major forces in the four continents came to see the Galaxy Light Silver Plate this time.
Chu Xinghe naturally knew what the purpose of these big guys was!
This is definitely a must-have when ordering next, right?
After all, although this kind of thing may not have much effect in a short period of time, a successful boss must not only look at immediate interests.
Inheritance is absolutely the most important thing for any force.
Look, even the many evil lords from Evil Shadow Continent have come to Haotian Holy Land!
Although the evil spirits in Evil Shadow Continent have various schemes and schemes, the evil spirits in Evil Shadow Continent must also have their own inheritance.
Once the Galaxy Light Silver Plate becomes popular, the third and fifth generations may not have much effect, but in the future, the number of geniuses born will become more and more.
No one would disdain their own disciples who are excellent!
The more outstanding one's disciples are in the future, the more secure one's own power will be.
Therefore, in this case, all parties must have made great efforts to place orders, and then purchased level-by-level silver plates to equip their own disciples.
This time will give everyone the most satisfactory answer!
So in this situation, has Chu Xinghe ever thought about whether he should jump out and get it for free?
But in the end Chu Xinghe gave up this plan!
Do you think I, Chu Xinghe, will eat less if you are given this for free?
What should I do if something new appears after it becomes free?
So after thinking about it, Chu Xinghe said no, I have to start from other places, I must completely destroy this opportunity of making money with the light of the galaxy!
So that day, Chu Xinghe found Ouyang Ming.
"Senior Brother Xinghe!"
"Well...Ouyang, come on, come on, and instill all the methods of making the Silver Plate of Galaxy Light into this jade charm of eternal life!"
"Ah? Okay...Okay!" Although Ouyang Ming didn't know why Brother Xinghe asked him to instill the crafting method into the eternal jade talisman, Ouyang Ming still did it without hesitation.
"Check it and make sure there are no errors!"
"Senior brother Xinghe, don't worry, there can be no mistakes!"
"Okay...you should do whatever you need to do..."
"Oh..." Ouyang Mingyi had a question mark on his forehead.
Chu Xinghe took the Jade Talisman of Eternal Life in his hand and checked it over and over again. There was nothing wrong with it. Everything in it was made using the Silver Plate of Light of Galaxy!
Holding this eternal life jade talisman, Chu Xinghe showed a smile on his face!
Transform! Daughter of the Seven Immortals!
In an instant, Chu Xinghe completed his transformation... and reincarnated into the daughter of the Seven Immortals of Xinghe Heizi Tuan!
Then Chu Xinghe took out the Black River Order that he got from Erluzi!
Find Erluzi’s contact information and send a message: “Are you there?”
Seeing that the message was sent, a sinister smile appeared on Chu Xinghe's face!
Hehehehehehe...that's right! This move is to solve the root cause of the problem of making money with the Galaxy Light Silver Plate!
Last time I leaked the refining method of the Heaven-stealing Sun-changing Pill, but it turned out that the Heaven-stealing Sun-changing Pill must be refined with a Suzaku Furnace? Is this too outrageous?
But this time, Chu Xinghe asked Ouyang Ming clearly, isn't it possible that only you, Ouyang Ming, can refine this silver plate of Galaxy Light?
In this regard, Ouyang Ming said, Brother Xinghe, don't worry, the refining method of this Galaxy's Light Silver Plate is simple, even a refiner can make it!
After hearing this answer, Chu Xinghe was still uneasy and asked Ouyang Ming again whether this thing requires any specific items to be refined, right?
Ou Yangming said there was no need for this... Such a simple thing can be refined in any refining furnace!
title_en: Chapter 2114 Are you there? Chapter 2113 Senior brother Xinghe has sympathy for me and Ou Yangming
